fields.problem:
Title: Closure of Cartesian Product is Product of Closures

Let $T_1 = \struct {S_1, \tau_1}$ and $T_2 = \struct {S_2, \tau_2}$ be [[Definition:Topological Space|topological spaces]].

Let $T = \struct {T_1 \times T_2, \tau}$ be the [[Definition:Product Space (Topology) of Two Factor Spaces|product space]] of $T_1$ and $T_2$, where $\tau$ is the [[Definition:Product Topology on Two Factor Spaces|product topology]] on $S$.

Let $H \subseteq T_1$ and $K \subseteq T_2$.

Then:
:$\map \cl {H \times K} = \map \cl H \times \map \cl K$
where $\map \cl H$, for example, denotes the [[Definition:Closure (Topology)|closure]] of $H$.

=== [[Closure of Cartesian Product is Product of Closures/Family|Indexed Family]] ===
{{:Closure of Cartesian Product is Product of Closures/Family}}
fields.source_context:
0001 | Consider the [[Definition:Relative Complement|relative complements]] of $H$ and $K$ in $T_1$ and $T_2$ respectively:
0002 | 
0003 | :$\overline H = \relcomp {S_1} H$
0004 | :$\overline K = \relcomp {S_2} K$
0005 | 
0006 | Then from [[Interior of Cartesian Product is Product of Interiors]]:
0007 | :$\Int {\overline H \times \overline K} = \Int {\overline H} \times \Int {\overline K}$
0008 | 
0009 | From [[Complement of Interior equals Closure of Complement]]:
0010 | 
0011 | :$\map \cl H = \Int {\overline H}$
0012 | :$\map \cl K = \Int {\overline K}$
0013 | :$\map \cl {H \times K} = \Int {\overline H \times \overline K}$
0014 | 
0015 | Hence the result.
0016 | {{qed}}
fields.witness: Let X = {0} with the discrete topology, and let H = {0} = X. Its relative complement X \ H is ∅. Here closure(H)=H={0}, while interior(X\H)=interior(empty)=empty; hence the displayed equality is false.

scope_metadata.target_scope: The equation closure(H)=interior(complement H); not closure of a product equaling the product of closures.
